title: Approval rerun workflows: workflow_run.workflows must name the trigger's `name:` field, while path-based filters use the filename
answers: After approving a PR, failed checks no longer get rerun automatically. Why did the rerun worker stop firing?
I'm renaming the approval trigger workflow file. What else has to change so the rerun still happens?
Why does retry.sh or protect.js ignore the rerun workflow by path, and how does that relate to the workflow name?
Where is the workflow_run filter for the approval rerun defined?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/trigger-rerun.yml (pull_request_review approval gate, `name: trigger-rerun`) feeds .github/workflows/rerun.yml (workflow_run worker that reruns failed checks at the PR head SHA). Path-based references to the worker also live in .github/workflows/retry.sh (rerun exclusion via workflow.resourcePath) and .github/workflows/protect.js:IGNORED_WORKFLOWS.
Rule: In rerun.yml, `on.workflow_run.workflows` matches the upstream workflow's `name:` value (trigger-rerun), not its filename. A mismatch makes the worker silently never run. Filters that read `workflow.resourcePath` use the filename, e.g. `endswith("/rerun.yml")` in retry.sh and `.github/workflows/trigger-rerun.yml` in protect.js. Renaming a file or its `name:` means updating the matching reference type in each place.
Symptom: After a maintainer approved a PR, the failed checks were not rerun, because the rerun worker's workflow_run filter did not match the trigger workflow's name.
Constraints: Applies whenever the approval trigger or the worker is renamed, or their `name:` changes. The mismatch is not caught by lint; it only appears at runtime after approval, so verify with a real approval or a review of the name fields.
applies: Scope: approval-triggered rerun workflows in .github/workflows (trigger-rerun.yml, rerun.yml) and their name or path references in retry.sh and protect.js; not other workflows.
says: Failed checks do not automatically rerun after a maintainer approves the pull request.
Approving a pull request fails to restart the failing continuous integration tests.
Broken checks stay failed after an approval review instead of retesting automatically.
Ensure pull request approval triggers rerun of failed jobs after workflow file changes.
Automatic rerun worker never triggers when an authorized reviewer approves a code submission.
search: In `.github/workflows/rerun.yml`, `on.workflow_run.workflows` must match the upstream workflow's `name:` attribute (`trigger-rerun`) from `.github/workflows/trigger-rerun.yml` rather than its YAML filename. Path-based filters such as `endswith('/rerun.yml')` in `.github/workflows/retry.sh` and `.github/workflows/protect.js:IGNORED_WORKFLOWS` depend on workflow filenames. A name mismatch causes the PR approval rerun worker to silently fail to trigger on approved reviews; renaming either workflow requires updating both name and path references across these files.
